Specification: This file contains a TLC model configuration module together with the full TLA+ specifications for a distributed bakery mutual exclusion algorithm and an auxiliary ProtoBakery test specification. The main algorithm models a distributed version of Lamport's bakery-style protocol over nodes communicating through message channels, with explicit write and ack messages, per-edge message handlers, and fairness assumptions for both node and edge processes; it checks type correctness, mutual exclusion, and starvation freedom. The design uses translated PlusCal processes, auxiliary variables such as numBar, tempBar, mustRdBar, and pcBar to relate to a ProtoBakery-style abstraction, and includes an instantiated auxiliary proof/test module via PB == INSTANCE ProtoBakeryTest WITH substitutions.
